icons.description: Pixel art league rank badge for a cybersecurity game: a front facing heraldic shield with a thick dark outline, shiny metal rim and a bold simple white symbol in the middle. Centered, transparent background, no text, no letters, no numbers. Bronze copper shield, symbol: a terminal command prompt, a right angle bracket followed by an underscore.
icons.processing: Alpha cut at 128. The prompt symbol was redrawn by hand as a white right angle bracket and underscore with a dark shadow.
